items.title: Claude Opus 5.5, GPT-6 Sol and Luna Launch at Lower Prices
items.summary: Anthropic put a new flagship model into the field: Claude Opus 5.5 drops to $4/$20 per million tokens, matching Claude Fable 5.1 on most tasks while costing 40% less to run than Opus 5, as OpenAI counters with cheaper GPT-6 Sol and Luna.

items.title: Anthropic says its biology lab has already found something big
items.summary: Anthropic's new Bay Area wet lab and life-sciences research group announced its first result: Claude agents autonomously identified a novel bacteriophage enzyme system with CRISPR-like repeat structures.
